questions.question_text: How many grams are there in exactly 4.75 kilograms?
Which of the following capital letters has exactly two lines of symmetry?
If a squirrel covers 3 steps in one jump, will it ever land on the number 16 if it starts from 0?
options: C) Only if it jumps backwards

questions.question_text: How many seconds are there in 6 and a half minutes?
On a map, if 1 cm represents 15 km on the ground, what actual distance does 4 cm represent?
A pattern of repeating shapes that completely covers a flat surface without any gaps or overlaps is called a:
In a pictograph, if one smiley face symbol represents 20 students, what do 3 and a half smiley faces represent?
A container holds 3 liters and 250 milliliters of juice. How much is this in milliliters?
If a race begins exactly at 11:45:10 AM and the runner crosses the finish line at 11:46:05 AM, what is the elapsed time?
One heavy coconut weighs 1.5 kg. What will be the total weight of 8 such identical coconuts?
Add the weights 4 kg 550 g and 2 kg 850 g. Provide the final total weight in kilograms and grams. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Adding the grams gives 1400 g, which equals 1 kg and 400 g. Adding the kilograms (4+2+1) makes the final total exactly 7 kg and 400 g.

questions.question_text: Describe how you can check if a leaf you found in the garden has a vertical line of symmetry. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You can carefully fold the leaf perfectly down its middle vertical vein. If both the left and right halves match and overlap exactly, it is symmetrical.

questions.question_text: A frog can leap exactly 1.5 meters in a single jump. How many jumps does it need to travel 12 meters? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the number of jumps, we divide the total distance of 12 meters by the jump length of 1.5 meters. The frog needs exactly 8 jumps.

questions.question_text: In a 100m sprint, Aryan finished in 14.8 seconds and Sameer finished in 15.3 seconds. Who won and by what time margin? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Aryan won the race because he took less time to finish. Subtracting 14.8 from 15.3, we find that he won by a margin of 0.5 seconds.

questions.question_text: On a map, the library is located directly North of the school, and the park is East of the school. Where is the park relative to the library? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Since the library is North of the school and the park is East of the school, the park is located in the South-East direction from the library.

questions.question_text: A dairy farmer collects a total of 25 liters and 600 mL of milk. He distributes it equally into 8 smaller containers. Calculate the exact capacity of milk stored in each container, showing your conversion step. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, convert the total milk entirely into milliliters. 25 liters is 25000 mL, plus 600 mL equals 25600 mL. Next, divide 25600 by 8, which gives exactly 3200 mL. Therefore, each individual container holds 3 liters and 200 milliliters of milk.

questions.question_text: A pictograph shows apples sold in a week. One full apple symbol represents 14 kilograms of apples. If Wednesday shows 6 full apple symbols and 1 half symbol, how many kilograms were sold? Explain the math. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: One full symbol represents 14 kg. So, 6 full symbols equal 6 multiplied by 14, which is 84 kg. A half symbol represents half of 14, which is 7 kg. Adding 84 kg and 7 kg gives a total of 91 kilograms sold.

sections.section_name: Section D - Mathematical Expression & Data Analysis

questions.question_text: Grandmother is sewing a rectangular quilt using 45 identical square fabric patches in a tessellated design. Each square patch has a side length of 12 cm. Calculate the total area of the finished quilt in square centimeters, showing the step-by-step multiplication. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, calculate the area of one single square patch by multiplying its side by itself: 12 cm multiplied by 12 cm equals 144 square centimeters. Next, multiply this single area by the total number of patches. 144 multiplied by 45 equals 6480. The total area of Grandmother's quilt is exactly 6480 square centimeters.

questions.question_text: A tourist map uses a scale where 1 cm represents 30 km. A tourist travels from City P to City Q (which measures 4.2 cm on the map) and then continues from City Q to City R (which measures 2.8 cm on the map). Find the total actual distance traveled in kilometers. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, find the total distance traveled on the map by adding the two segments: 4.2 cm plus 2.8 cm gives a total map distance of 7.0 cm. Since 1 cm on the map represents 30 km in reality, we multiply 7 by 30. The tourist traveled a total actual distance of 210 kilometers.
